_readme: FICTIONAL PRESENTATION ONLY. Nothing here is a claim about a model's capability or availability. Characters are unofficial, original interpretations; they are not affiliated with or endorsed by any model creator, and use no official artwork. Technical facts live in ../manifest/contenders.json.
disclaimer: Unofficial interpretation. Original artwork. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the model's creators.

Qwen.lore: A capybara in teal robes who never hurries. Rumour says the Sage has read every scroll twice, and answers only once both readings agree.

DeepSeek.lore: A hooded presence that surfaces from the lowest tier of the arena. It thinks in long silences and speaks only when the pattern is complete.

Llama.lore: A bespectacled llama with a mortarboard older than the arena itself. Carries one very long scroll and cites it constantly.

Gemma.lore: A floating lattice of living glass. Every facet reflects the problem from a different angle; the Mind claims clarity is just enough angles.

Grok.lore: Half bright, half shadow, entirely unannounced. The Challenger enters mid-bout and treats the rules as suggestions the judges will quietly correct.

agent-qwen-research.lore: The Capybara Sage after a season in the archive: monocle, open ledger, and a strict habit of separating what is known from what is guessed.

agent-qwen-quant.lore: The Archivist, further specialised: an abacus-framed variant that audits every quantity. Fiction only — it trades nothing and touches no funds.

agent-qwen-verifier.lore: The Sage with a second halo — one for the answer, one for the check.

agent-deepseek-verifier.lore: The Abyssal Oracle, ringed by a confirming glyph. It looks twice before it speaks.

agent-local-qwen-verifier.lore: The Sage with a second halo — one for the answer, one for the check.
